hypothesis: A direct support-mask plus support-ordered-sign representation can execute exact k=64 ternary Qwen3.8-27B MLP GEMV on one x86 CPU core at no less than half the throughput of the mature aligned two-bit AVX2 control, while using exactly 1.5 raw code bits per weight and no more than 1.57 projected component bits per weight after the frozen row-scale and learned-hash correction ledger

scope.claim_boundary: synthetic exact-support full-shape microkernel only; not a complete layer, fused learned-hash correction, token-throughput, model-quality, semi-lossless, or breakthrough result

representation.layout: little-endian 128-bit support mask followed by one support-ordered 64-bit sign mask
representation.decode_strategy: BMI2 PDEP expands signs into support positions; a 256-entry nibble LUT expands ternary digits for AVX2 maddubs
representation.canonical_storage_control: the separately frozen 189-bit enumerative k64 codec remains the smaller exact on-disk representation; mask64 is the runtime representation

measurement.codes: deterministic synthetic exact-64-support {-1,0,+1} groups generated in bounded-memory batches
measurement.activation: deterministic signed INT8 with per-group FP32 scales
measurement.weight_scales: per-row FP16 anchors plus packed 4-bit per-group FP16-ratio indices
measurement.threading: one process pinned to one physical CPU; both kernels are single-threaded
measurement.comparison: mask64 AVX2 BMI2 direct GEMV versus the existing aligned group128 two-bit AVX2 row-scale4 GEMV on identical codes scales and activation
measurement.timing_order: alternated by case to reduce systematic first-run bias
measurement.compiler: system C compiler with C11 O3 Wall Wextra Werror shared PIC and mtune=native

promotion_rules: every case must independently meet every frozen correctness storage and performance threshold
the aligned two-bit control must use identical ternary codes scale metadata and activation
the projected component ledger counts mask64 codes 4-bit group scales learned-route metadata and ratio-128 packed INT4 correction A with row scales
the learned route may be shared by gate and up in a whole-layer ledger but is conservatively counted in each standalone component here
a failed gate remains a useful terminal result and requires a separately versioned optimization before rerun
infrastructure-invalid work is neither a zero nor a completed result
Qwen 4B compute is forbidden in this research lane
this benchmark cannot establish semi-lossless compression model capability token throughput or a scientific breakthrough
